title: Four AI Agents Scan a Business's Whole Web Presence | vitalii.no
description:
Deciding what kind of free sample to offer a business — and writing a prompt an AI generation tool could actually use — meant manually opening its website and every social profile by hand, guessing how much content it already had, and writing a one-off prompt from scratch every single time.

runner/crawl.mjs now crawls a business's site along with its public Facebook, Instagram, LinkedIn, TikTok and YouTube profiles. runner/scan.mjs scores how much content already exists, and runner/agents.mjs chains four roles — a visual pass, an analyst, a prompt writer and a reviewer — into an editable generation prompt plus reference and sample galleries, shown in the app as a selection button, a live content indicator and an analysis workspace. runner/runner.mjs was rewritten to run up to three of these scans side by side instead of one at a time, and every agent step now logs its own token cost.

A usable generation prompt and a sense of a business's existing content now come out of an automated scan instead of manual research and guesswork. Three businesses can be scanned at once instead of one, and every scan's real cost is recorded instead of guessed.
